job.job_description:
Hot Duties:

Build AI-native SaaS applications using modern full-stack technologies
Leverage AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, etc.) to accelerate design, coding, testing, debugging, and documentation
Develop AI-powered solutions using LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, and MCP
Design scalable APIs and cloud-native architectures integrating AI capabilities
Apply AI-assisted and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) to improve engineering productivity and software quality
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and drive innovation

Duties:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable AI-enabled SaaS applications and cloud-native services
Build full-stack applications, REST APIs, microservices, and AI-powered workflows
Integrate LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, and MCP into production-grade solutions
Use AI-assisted engineering to accelerate development, testing, debugging, code reviews, and documentation
Design secure, scalable architectures with relational, NoSQL, and vector databases
Optimize application performance, reliability, scalability, and cloud costs
Implement CI/CD pipelines, containerization, observability, and automated quality practices
Review code, enforce engineering standards, and mentor engineers on AI-first development practices
Troubleshoot complex production issues, including AI model integrations and distributed systems
Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend improvements that enhance product capabilities and engineering productivity

Requirements:

4 to 6 years of full-stack software development experience
Good Python expertise with FastAPI, Flask, or Django
Proficiency in one or more languages such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or Node.js
Experience with React, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks
Good knowledge of REST APIs, microservices, OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns
Hands-on experience with AWS (preferred), Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
Good knowledge of PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQL Server and NoSQL databases
Experience with AI technologies such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Bedrock, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, RAG, MCP, and vector databases
Knowledge of Kafka/RabbitMQ, OAuth2/JWT, monitoring tools, and secure software development
Good problem-solving, communication, ownership, and mentoring skills


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
